name: shelly-shabbat-controller
description: Shabbat & Yom Tov relay controller for Shelly - build, format and test tooling

scripts.test: npm run build && node tools/check_docs.mjs && node test/inflate_test.js && node test/sim.js && FLAGS=1 QUICK=1 node test/sim.js && node --no-warnings test/service_test.mjs && node test/ui_test.js
scripts.check:ref: node tools/gen_ref.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- test/dates test/windows.json
scripts.service:schema: npx --yes wrangler@4.153.0 d1 execute shabbat-schedule --remote --file service/schema.sql -c service/wrangler.toml
